## Foundry Call Center - operations
Source: Application Insights spans emitted by the chat backend (`chat_turn`, `classify`, `specialist`). Message content is never recorded. Cost uses gpt-4.1-mini list prices ($0.40 / $1.60 per 1M input / output tokens); adjust the KQL if the deployment changes.

content.title: Health: turns, errors, guardrail blocks
content.query: dependencies | where name == 'chat_turn' | summarize Turns = count(), Errors = countif(success == false), GuardrailBlocks = countif(tostring(customDimensions.guardrail) != ''), ErrorRatePct = round(100.0 * countif(success == false) / count(), 1) by bin(timestamp, 1h) | order by timestamp asc

content.title: Routing: intent mix
content.query: dependencies | where name == 'chat_turn' | summarize Turns = count() by Intent = tostring(customDimensions.intent)

content.title: Latency (ms): p50 / p95 by stage
content.query: dependencies | where name == 'chat_turn' | extend classify = todouble(customDimensions.classify_ms), ttft = todouble(customDimensions.ttft_ms), total = todouble(customDimensions.total_ms) | summarize classify_p50 = percentile(classify, 50), classify_p95 = percentile(classify, 95), first_token_p50 = percentile(ttft, 50), first_token_p95 = percentile(ttft, 95), total_p50 = percentile(total, 50), total_p95 = percentile(total, 95) by bin(timestamp, 1h) | order by timestamp asc

content.title: Tool use (specialist calls)
content.query: dependencies | where name == 'specialist' | extend Tool = split(tostring(customDimensions.tools), ',') | mv-expand Tool to typeof(string) | where isnotempty(Tool) | summarize Calls = count() by Agent = tostring(customDimensions.agent), Tool | order by Calls desc

content.title: Cost: tokens and estimated USD per day
content.query: dependencies | where name == 'chat_turn' | extend inTok = todouble(customDimensions.orchestrator_input_tokens) + todouble(customDimensions.specialist_input_tokens), outTok = todouble(customDimensions.orchestrator_output_tokens) + todouble(customDimensions.specialist_output_tokens) | summarize InputTokens = sum(inTok), OutputTokens = sum(outTok), Turns = count() by Day = bin(timestamp, 1d) | extend EstUSD = round(InputTokens * 0.40 / 1000000 + OutputTokens * 1.60 / 1000000, 4), EstUSDPerTurn = round((InputTokens * 0.40 + OutputTokens * 1.60) / 1000000 / Turns, 5) | order by Day asc

content.title: Failures by stage
content.query: dependencies | where name in ('classify', 'specialist') and success == false | summarize Failures = count() by Stage = name, Agent = tostring(customDimensions.agent), ErrorType = tostring(customDimensions.error_type)

content.title: Slowest recent turns (use operation_Id to open the end-to-end trace)
content.query: dependencies | where name == 'chat_turn' | project timestamp, operation_Id, member = tostring(customDimensions.member_id), intent = tostring(customDimensions.intent), agent = tostring(customDimensions.agent), tools = tostring(customDimensions.tools), total_ms = todouble(customDimensions.total_ms), success | top 25 by total_ms desc
